svg.aria-label: The 2055 question as the overriding decision filter
svg.title: The 2055 question
svg.desc: Large central card with the question: will I be proud of this in 2055.
svg.text: Will I be proud of this in 2055?
If you have to convince yourself, the answer is no.
If you don't hesitate, build it. Everything else is noise.
